text:
Estimated items served: one slice of whole-grain toast (about 90 kcal), one fried or poached egg (about 90 kcal), about half an avocado sliced (about 120 kcal), a lemon wedge (about 3 kcal), and a mug of tea with milk (about 20 kcal). That totals about 323 kcal, rounded to 320.

Leftovers: a small avocado piece (about 10 kcal), the lemon wedge (about 3 kcal), and a little egg yolk and avocado smear on the plate (about 7 kcal). That is about 20 kcal. The toast, most of the egg, and the tea were eaten.

Eaten: 320 − 20 = 300 kcal.

Macronutrients eaten (approximate):
- Protein: toast about 4 g, egg about 6 g, avocado about 1.5 g, milk about 0.5 g, so about 12 g.
- Carbohydrate: toast about 15 g, avocado about 6 g, milk about 1 g, so about 22 g.
- Fat: egg about 7 g, avocado about 14 g, toast about 1 g, so about 22 g.
